summary_md: **Tommy ([@tommy_jtl](https://x.com/tommy_jtl/status/2116785328455549434))** demos an alpha of **Torque**, a resident agent project for programmable hardware, on an Arduino UNO Q with a TE M-1 mic ([tommyjtl/torque](https://github.com/tommyjtl/torque)).

referenced_urls.title: GitHub - tommyjtl/torque: A resident agent project for programmable hardware.

media.description: A small device built from an Arduino UNO Q stack with a touchscreen, gooseneck microphone and battery pack, propped on a wooden block.
Side view of the Arduino UNO Q agent device showing the stacked boards, ribbon cable and battery.
Top view of the device with its touchscreen, LED matrix and gooseneck microphone.
Close-up of the device touchscreen showing a terminal session.
